_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 93 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: M320A1 THRM

description.text: Fires impact-triggered thermobaric grenades, ideal for targeting groups of hostiles. The blast delivers limited initial damage but stuns and burns enemies for a short duration. Can be carried standalone or underslung on weapons with a Gadget Mount attachment for faster access.

_unlock_note: Unlock recorded 2026-08-02 from Battlefield 6's own in-game unlock and challenge data. Not from the screenshot cited above: unlock text only displays in-game on items the account does not own.
